note: Every extracted function, where it came from, and the commit it was taken from. A difference in output must always be traceable to a decision somebody recorded, not to a refactor nobody did.

extracts.changes: export added; optional radiusKm parameter added (defaults to the V8 value, so existing behaviour is bit-identical); EARTH_MEAN_RADIUS_KM and haversineMean added as new, not substituted.

Implementations A (134-149) and B (481-490) were verified numerically identical and collapsed into polygonAreaKm2. The acre conversion now uses the exact 4046.85642 m2/acre from A rather than B's rounded 247.105 acres/km2. Implementation C (576-582) kept separate and unmerged: different question, correct as written.

The two identical destination-point implementations (verified 0 absolute difference over 64 points) collapsed into one; the point count became an argument, which was the only real difference between them.
The FeatureCollection-wrapping half of createGeoJSONCircle, separated from the ring generation so a caller wanting coordinates does not depend on a GeoJSON shape it never reads.

LAYER_ID_FOR_BUCKET and layerIdForBucket copied verbatim from the receiver (introduced gridatlas generation 202609041244 / v9.109; first carried to production in generation 202609041330 / v9.111). REPD_LAYER_IDS copied verbatim. buildDeepLink and parseDeepLink are NEW: the emitter and receiver each had their own inline URL handling and neither was a reusable function.

The IIFE and the window.__GRIDATLAS_MODULES__ registration were removed; every function is otherwise byte-identical to the source, including the atan2 operand order that the source insists on for numerical parity with V8 haversine(). Parity is asserted bit-for-bit by proofs/v9-engine.proof.mjs rather than assumed.

Import path repointed to ./v9-geodesy.js. NOTE: this module is committed to gridatlas but appears in NO composition manifest — nothing loads it. The live Atlas reimplements normalise()/nearest() inline in its substation-intelligence cartridge, byte-different, and the live copy lacks the `voltages_kv || []` default this one has, so the live copy can throw where this cannot. Neither has a bbox/ring pre-filter; both are exhaustive scans and therefore free of the ring-search bug class.
